description: Windah rides a dirt bike to the 'lompat dengan motor' mystery and launches off a ramp over a valley: the cinematic-cam jump, 'epic', 'nice'. Source = .cache/wizzclip/windah-gtavi-lompat/source.mp4 (also Drive clip-src/windah-gtavi-lompat.mp4): four pieces (0.6 s padding each) of windah-live9/stream-2059-2124.mp4 (p2, file t 0 = 20:59 WIB) in output order, 1080p30 re-encoded and joined. Cuts: T t 209.30-210.50 = local 0.60-1.80 -> output 0.00-1.20; A t 201.35-206.90 = local 3.00-8.55 -> output 1.20-6.75; B t 207.40-214.55 = local 9.75-16.90 -> output 6.75-13.90; C t 215.30-224.25 = local 18.10-27.05 -> output 13.90-22.85. Beats in stream order: frame-0 teaser (p2 3:29, the bike in the air, cinematic cam, 1.2 s); 'misteri lompat dengan motor dan salto...' over the run-up (3:21); the jump from the cinematic cam and the landing, 'gak bisa 2x' (3:27-3:34); 'epic', 'yes', 'stunt jumps 5 of 130', 'nice' (3:35-3:44). Word timings from medium faster-whisper (the 'gak bisa 2x' line is a low-confidence transcription: check by ear). NOT USED: the run-up tail 5:45-6:27 (the recording ends mid run-up, no result) and the 'ritual setan' remarks (5:56). The game crop (704,410,800) leaves out the on-screen hint boxes and counters; no brand text, guns or revealing outfits in frame. The facecam crop (1568,516,352,264) stops above the chest logo on his shirt. Main 22.85 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first). Facecam-below layout (windah_recipe.py layout 'face'): gameplay = source crop 800x450 at (704,410) scaled to 1080x608 at y364 (the corner facecam is outside the crop, no blur), Windah's facecam = source crop 352x264 at (1568,516) scaled to 520x390 in a 4 px Volt frame, centred at x276, y994-1392, clear of TikTok's bottom caption area and right icon column; hook line 1 Paper 'MISTERI LOMPAT MOTOR', line 2 Volt 'SALTO DI UDARA', Audex 68, bottom-anchored at y318; credit tag y326; subs at y905 over the lower gameplay panel. Word timings from faster-whisper medium on boosted audio. Cuts on input 0 stay in source order; an earlier-shown later moment has its own seeked input.
